summary: John's 4th great-uncle; infant brother of Maria Anna, died weeks after their father.
bio: A small child, 'ehelicher Sohn des verstorbenen … Schreiners Servaz Birkenmaier, und der Agatha geb. Heizler'; died about three weeks after his father (19 Apr 1853).
